reviews.title: NEVER AGAIN
reviews.text:
I am extremely frustrated with my VIU Premium subscription. I upgraded my account specifically to enjoy unlimited downloads and ad-free viewing, but instead I’ve been dealing with constant errors and technical issues.

Many of the series I want to watch either fail to play or keep showing error messages, making it impossible to enjoy the content. What’s even more disappointing is that some series can’t be downloaded at all, despite unlimited downloads being one of the main reasons I paid for the upgrade.

It feels unfair to pay for premium features that don’t work as advertised. I expected a smooth and hassle-free experience, but instead I’m wasting time troubleshooting issues that should not exist in a paid service. Unless these problems are fixed soon, I will seriously reconsider keeping my subscription.

reviews.title: Playback Errors Despite Strong Internet Connection
reviews.text:
I love watching K-dramas on this app, but it’s really frustrating when the momentum suddenly stops because of an error saying “Please connect to a better network”—even though I’m already on a stable internet connection.

What’s worse is that the issue seems to be tied to a specific Kdrama Title/video that I’m currently watching. Other K-dramas play perfectly fine, but when I go back to that particular Kdrama Title, the same error keeps showing up. I’ve tried everything: uninstalling and reinstalling the app, switching networks, and even jumping to other episodes, but the problem still doesn’t go away.

It honestly ruins the viewing experience and is so annoying. I hope this gets fixed soon because the content is great, but issues like this make it hard to enjoy.

reviews.title: No Internet Connection Error
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Viu for years, but the experience lately has become extremely frustrating. The app keeps telling me I have “no internet connection,” yet every other app on my device works perfectly but Viu somehow manages to load all its ads without any problem.

If the app can deliver ads, then it clearly does have internet access. The issue is on your end: either the servers, the recent update, or your app optimization. This is unacceptable for a long-time user.

Please look into this immediately and release a fix. Your users deserve a functioning app, not an experience that blocks the main content while the ads run smoothly.
